capabilities.name: Triage a request
capabilities.description: A free-text request for a person to read and decide what to do. Used when a task names no capability; it always goes to a human.

capabilities.name: Answer from the company model
capabilities.description: Answer a question from the company model and records Quicksilver already holds. Read-only.

capabilities.name: Summarize the books
capabilities.description: Summarize the money ledger for a period: revenue, spend, refunds and reserve. Read-only; moves no money.

capabilities.name: Draft outreach
capabilities.description: Draft an outreach message for a person to review. Nothing is sent.

capabilities.name: Read Forkling records
capabilities.description: Read Forkling's deployed records and results. Forkling is frozen: read-only, and no task may change it.
